_comment: Where a visitor goes to find out why a platform has no build in the current release, and when it is coming back. Read by scripts/update-version-info.py and merged into version.json -> latest_release.platform_tracking, which public/index.html renders (renderPlatformClaims -> appendAbsenceClause). A pinned value belongs in a data file with a source note, never a script literal.
_rules: An entry is only ever SHOWN for a platform that has no build in the current release; when the build ships, the platform stops being 'missing' and the link is never rendered. A stale entry is therefore inert, not a lie -- but delete it once its issue closes.
Adding a key here asserts nothing about availability. That is derived from the release assets by derive_platforms(), and this file cannot override it.

macos.why: The macOS export failed inside the v0.14.3 build job. The upload step is if-no-files-found: warn, so the release published green over an empty directory.
macos.source: public/index.html as it stood on main 2026-08-25, which linked this issue in hand-written prose; this file is where that link moves so it survives the next update-version-info.py run.
